mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_option (question_id, content, sort_no) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{content}, #{sortNo})
mapper.select: SELECT id, question_id, content, sort_no FROM t_option WHERE question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_option WHERE question_id IN (SELECT id FROM t_question WHERE questionnaire_id = #{questionnaireId})
